message.content: {"version":"1","answer":{"chosen":[{"id":"o9","why":"A monochromatic warm-neutral base with a bold red accent and silver sparkle, covered by a heavy wool coat to handle the frost."},{"id":"o6","why":"A sophisticated graphite-on-grey monochrome suit that reads formal, softened by warm brown boots and a high-luxury red bag for the party vibe."}],"outfits":[{"id":"o9","caption":"Warm-neutral velvet trousers with bold red clutch","pole":"filter_and_rank|anchor_first|tonal_column|ease_the_knot|break|free","items":["#86·17","#532·06","#480·31","#544·15","#372·21","#222·17"],"day":"Taupe wide-leg trousers offer an elegant alternative to black; the brown jacket is swapped for a structured cashmere coat to handle the frost, while the red bag adds festive sparkle."},{"id":"o6","caption":"Graphite blazer with grey trousers and chocolate boots","pole":"anchor_first|tonal_column|ease_the_knot|break|free","items":["#495·11","#298·35","#318·05","#224·06"],"day":"A sophisticated graphite-on-grey monochrome look that reads smart and formal; the brown ankle boots add warmth against the frost, while the red bag provides the necessary accent for the celebration."}],"needed":[{"kind":"outerwear","description":"A structured cashmere coat is needed to provide the required 3 layers of warmth for the frosty weather.","type":"coat","color":"neutral_warm","fabric":"cashmere"}]}}
